## Industry watch checklist

- [ ] Sourced only — every entry has at least one public source URL
- [ ] Allegations labelled — set `allegation` to `true` when the item is an allegation
- [ ] No generative-model vendor or model names
- [ ] No confidential figures
- [ ] `industry-watch/feed.xml` rebuilt with `node scripts/build-industry-watch-feed.mjs`
